branches.name: delegated_agent
branches.sourceExpression: ((((((((actor.kind == PrincipalKind.AGENT) and (actor.status == PrincipalStatus.ACTIVE)) and (delegation.agent == actor)) and (delegation.status == DelegationStatus.ACTIVE)) and (delegation.capability == Capability.REQUEST_PRODUCTION_DEPLOY)) and (delegation.environment == environment)) and (delegation.org == actor.org)) and (environment.org == actor.org))

branches.name: independent_approver
branches.sourceExpression: (((((actor.kind == PrincipalKind.HUMAN) and (actor.status == PrincipalStatus.ACTIVE)) and (Role.APPROVER in actor.roles)) and (actor.org == request.org)) and (actor != request.requestedBy))

authorization.name: authorize
authorization.sourceExpression: ((((actor.kind == PrincipalKind.HUMAN) and (actor.status == PrincipalStatus.ACTIVE)) and (Role.ADMIN in actor.roles)) and (actor.org == request.org))
